authority.reason: Profile 01 pinned analyzeBrep on a subject without BRep evidence as failed with GEOSPEC_BREP_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE and the evidence {success:false}. Under the ruling, inspectGeometry, analyzeMeshOverlap and analyzeBrep refuse instead of failing when the evidence they read is missing or cannot decide, as minimumDistance and queryPmi already do. A refused result keeps the diagnostic and its code and carries no evidence.
